_doc.name: WorkmAIn Intent Parse — Generation Config
_doc.description: Generation parameters for Mistral 7B intent parsing via Ollama. max_tokens here is Modelfile build input only (num_predict) — nothing in workmain reads it; the runtime cap lives in config/ai_settings.json's application_functions.intent_parse. temperature/top_p/top_k/repeat_penalty are baked into the Modelfile and are the editable reference for rebuilds.
_doc.version_authority: Version metadata (config_version, config_updated, model_built) is maintained exclusively in config/intent_parse_system_prompt.txt header.

generation_options._comment: Reference only — runtime source of truth is Modelfile PARAMETER blocks.
